subtasks.task_text: Explain the initial phase of the Green Revolution and the introduction of new crop varieties.
subtasks.text: Observe the introduction of high yielding crop varieties as the starting point of the Green Revolution.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the benefits of high-yielding crop varieties in terms of increased yields compared to traditional crops.
subtasks.text: Note that these crops produced significantly higher yields than traditional ones.

subtasks.task_text: Discuss the additional measures that further increased crop growth during the Green Revolution.
subtasks.text: Notice the use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides to boost crop growth.

subtasks.task_text: Explain the overall impact of the Green Revolution on global agriculture and food production.
subtasks.text: Observe that this combination revolutionized agriculture, increasing food production globally.
